name: password-manager-resources
description_en: A place for creators and users of password managers to collaborate on resources to make password management better.
readme_excerpt: Password Manager Resources Welcome! The Password Manager Resources project exists so creators of password managers can collaborate on resources to make password management better for users. Resources currently consist of data, or "quirks", as well as code. "Quirk" is a term from web browser development that refers to a website-specific, hard-coded behavior to work around an issue with a website that can't be fixed in a principled, universal way. In this project, it has the same meaning. Althoug…
